inventory.objective: Notice how a pattern repeats or grows, and continue it.
inventory.intro: Aava makes stone and shell rows.
demo: ABB repeated twice, then next A; patternScene
ABC,ABC,A partial unit, then B; patternScene
growScene(2,2): old figure retained plus two new dots

families.repeat: choose next shape, at least2 unit repeats plus partial phase
families.extend: construct3 next pictures in palette, position-specific why, empty/replace possible
families.grow: arithmetic sequence s=1..5,d=2..5; choose fifth term
families.dots: growing visual s=1..3,d=2..3; choose next total
families.transfer: given ABB rule; identify erroneous position in9 symbols; bad index3..8

hints: construct from the remaining partial unit
explanations: specific target for each of3 slots
inventory.audit: LESSON_AUDIT repeating/growing section: bracket unit, show additions, add extend; why differs by phase and growth error. Coverage is stale: omits extend and retains old revision.
inventory.animationReading: patternScene lays items/brackets full and partial units; reveal=false hides next. growScene keeps old dots and colours new; reveal=false last figure becomes ?.

registry.declarations: No per-node/wildcard/family DECL override; generic choice/extend outcomes.

planning.teacherObjective: Havaita sovitun toistuvan osan vaihe ja rakentaa sen jatko sekä erottaa tästä vanhan säilyttävä, vakion verran kasvava kuvio.
planning.childGoal: Löydän toistuvan osan tai muutoksen ja jatkan kuviota.

strongSupport.rationale: M-TH-01 on tämän osaamiskohteen välitön välttämätön esitieto. v0.2: ei käytetä kovana avausporttina, koska kyse on prosessi-/representaatiotuesta.

assumed: M-TH-01 is strong process support, no hard lock.
Shape/form cues suffice; formal geometric names and colour discrimination are unnecessary.
Numeric growth labels invoke counting/addition; show pictorial increments and state those content assumptions rather than treating them as universal prerequisites.
planning.scope: AB:n konkreettinen aloitus ja ABB:n kahden kokonaisen sekä yhden osittaisen jakson jatkaminen kolmella kuvalla. Muokattava oma jatko korvaa erillisen valmiin virherivin tehtävän. Kasvu: mallin2,4,6 jälkeen kuusi vanhaa kopioituna ja omien uusien pisteiden lisääminen/poisto; tavoite2 uutta. Avoimet muut säännöt jäävät opettajan keskusteluun.
planning.evidenceLimits: Tämä tarkistus koskee sovittua toistoa ja +2-kasvua; äärellinen alku ei määritä ainoaa ääretöntä sääntöä. Mallissa annetaan lukumääriä ja kuusi vanhaa pistettä kopioituna. No persistence, mastery awards, efficacy claim or human validation.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Frozen canonical band/roles/groups/relations retained. Foreign educational guidance corroborates design; it is not new Finnish OPS evidence. Story, numerical bounds, original diagrams, manual steps and constructive checks are project design.

assetProvenance.origin: Original subject diagram authored for this KC on2026-10-29; no copied research-source figures.
Local scoped presentation, no URL/at-rule/escape/dependency; original dynamic SVGs are local source code.
Unmodified user-supplied v2 generated raster interpretation; not asserted hand-drawn original; actual shared PNG SHA256, no duplication.
assetProvenance.display: Named static introduction at96×96, no decorative motion or new pose.

interactionType: Construct3 missing next tokens in an ABB row; replace/undo and check each position.
Repair one wrong pictured token by touching the picture itself, no “name the nth object” demand.
Build the next growth figure using add/remove pieces; checker validates the next construction under the stated +2 rule.
planning.support: Optional brackets and a movable pointer through one unit; simpler AB first.
planning.offline: Loose object rows and copied growing paper figures; adult accepts other coherent proposed rules in open discussion.
planning.advanced: Use a different starting phase or create a different representation of the same unit; discuss why a longer composite block can also repeat.
planning.exitQuestion: Mikä osa toistuu — tai mikä muutos tapahtuu joka kerta?
planning.accessibility: Native buttons >=48px target in scoped CSS; explicit aria labels and pressed states, visible chosen targets, polite feedback; no drag, mandatory audio, speech check, object-name production or timed response. Manual model steps; root controls disable while paused.
planning.reviewStatus: Revised after independent Hume P2 finding; author targeted regression checks passed. Targeted independent rereview, main integration and human testing remain separate.
